metadata.title: UAE Quaternary aquifer groundwater depth + decline zones — Phase 1 v0.1
metadata.data_origin: Polygons digitised from cited peer-reviewed UAE Quaternary aquifer studies. NOT precision contour data — coarse representative zones for Phase 1 v0.1 demonstration.
metadata.intended_use: Phase 1 v0.1 informational layer — cite-able source for 'this region has shallow groundwater + active depletion' on parcel page. Replace with MoCCAE / FAO AQUASTAT raster once direct API/download access is secured.
blocker_log: MoCCAE Environmental Geospatial Platform (gis.moccae.gov.ae) returned 'request rejected' to anonymous fetch on 2026-04-26 — requires authenticated/authorised access.
FAO AQUASTAT (data.apps.fao.org/aquastat/) provides UAE country-level aggregates only; spatial raster of water-table depth not openly available for download.
Bayanat.ae national data portal — not browsed in this acquisition session due to time budget; Phase 2 follow-up.
citations: MDPI Water 2021, 13, 864 — Spatial and Temporal Changes of Groundwater Storage in the Quaternary Aquifer, UAE — https://www.mdpi.com/2073-4441/13/6/864
MDPI Water 2025, 17, 21 — Groundwater Storage Assessment in Abu Dhabi Emirate — https://www.mdpi.com/2073-4441/17/21
Springer Discover Sustainability 2025 — Sustainable groundwater control in Sabkha (AD Metropolitan) — https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s43621-025-01187-9

schema.depth_estimate_m: approximate depth to water table in metres; NULL when zone is depletion-rate-defined
schema.decline_rate_m_per_year: documented or estimated rate of water table fall
schema.foundation_implication: narrative — what this means for foundation design

properties.foundation_implication: Dewatering required for any basement >2m below grade. Sulphate-resistant cement mandatory due to brackish water. Standard Dubai coastal practice.
properties.source: MDPI Water 2021 + Dubai borehole averages (4.5-4.6m) per general geotech reports

properties.foundation_implication: Documented 80m water table drop in 25 years (~3.2 m/yr). Significant land subsidence risk; correlate with Layer 1 InSAR. Foundation design must account for ongoing settlement.
properties.source: Springer Discover Sustainability 2025 — Al Khazna agricultural area, ~40km W of Al Ain

properties.foundation_implication: Deep water table; foundation design dominated by bearing capacity not groundwater. Aquifer depletion ongoing — long-term subsidence risk.
properties.source: MDPI Water 2025 — Abu Dhabi Emirate Quaternary aquifer assessment
